answer: Each submission hangs on the crystal of a task receipt, and the anchor is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. By the timber of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, reduced by each unverified claim, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
